countries.reasoning: South Africa is the largest producer of iridium based on USGS 2023 data with well-documented mining output, primarily from the Bushveld Complex; high confidence due to reliable government and industry data.
Russia is a significant iridium producer mainly from Norilsk Nickel operations; data from company reports and USGS 2023 supports strong confidence though some reporting lag exists.

Zimbabwe contributes notably to global iridium supply from the Great Dyke mining region; estimates based on industry reports and regional production data with moderate confidence due to occasional reporting gaps.
US iridium production comes from secondary sources associated with platinum group metals; USGS 2022 and industry data used with moderate confidence due to smaller scale and less frequent updates.
Canada produces minor amounts of iridium as a byproduct from PGM mining in the Sudbury Basin; data is limited but consistent enough for this low confidence estimate.
